in_use.name: Free.ai

allowance.value: 30,000 tokens a day for email-confirmed accounts; we saw about 33,000 on a day

in_use.note: API access works on the free tier through its OpenAI-style endpoint. When the day's free pool is spent, it says to wait for tomorrow's.

in_use.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini API)

allowance.value: free of charge on Flash models; Google publishes no number outside AI Studio. We saw the free daily quota run out at about 500 to 670 requests a day

in_use.note: On the free tier, Google says content is used to improve its products. AI Studio says no card is required.

in_use.name: Groq

allowance.value: gpt-oss-120b: 1,000 requests a day, 200,000 tokens a day; 30 requests and 8,000 tokens a minute

recycle.value: the daily token limit is rolling: a refusal says how long to wait

request.value: 8,000 tokens: a larger request is refused outright

in_use.note: Token limits bind long before request limits. Groq prints no card statement for the Free plan.

in_use.name: MegaNova AI

allowance.value: 550 a day in total across its Tier 1 free models, 50 a day on each model; the unit is not named (the page says "free quota"). We saw one model's day limit reached after 42 of our calls

in_use.note: Free tier is called Tier 1. The page says use continues as paid if the account's charge switch is turned on, so keep it off if you want free only.

in_use.name: Mistral (La Plateforme, Free mode)

card.value: no card, but see the note

in_use.note: Mistral's docs, as we read them on 21 Nov, say Free mode has no API access, while our older account still answers, with 2 requests a minute (that figure has moved before: it was 30 on 6 Nov). Do not count on API access on Mistral's free mode as a new reader.

in_use.name: OpenRouter (:free models)

allowance.value: 20 requests a minute and 50 requests a day on :free models; 1,000 a day after buying 10 credits

recycle.value: daily, counted per UTC day (midnight UTC)

in_use.note: Counted in requests, not tokens. No card is needed for the :free models.

in_use.name: Token Harbor

allowance.value: allowance is a list-price value over a rolling 7 x 24 hours from the first free request; the amount is not published. 60 requests a minute and 1,800 an hour

in_use.note: Two free models: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and MiMo V2.6 Flash.

in_use.name: Z.ai (GLM Flash models)

allowance.value: GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash are listed at $0; no token or call amount is published

in_use.note: Replies carry no rate-limit header, so you learn your limit by using it.

left_off.name: Aion Labs
left_off.free_allowance: A daily credit allowance (size not published) for agent jobs, the API and browser chat
left_off.public_note: Aion Labs lists a free tier with a daily credit allowance, but API access is activated by verifying a payment card (stated as never charged).

left_off.name: Cerebras
left_off.free_allowance: Free Trial: $5 credit for 30 days; gpt-oss-120b 5 requests a minute, 1M tokens a day
left_off.recycle: daily; credits expire 30 days after grant
left_off.public_note: Cerebras gives $5 of trial credit for 30 days (gpt-oss-120b: 5 requests a minute, 1M tokens a day), but API access stays inactive until a payment method is added.

left_off.name: GitHub Copilot Free
left_off.free_allowance: 2,000 inline completions a month; limited chat and agent use; AI credits allowance (size not stated)
left_off.public_note: GitHub Copilot Free is an editor and chat feature, not an API: it gives 2,000 completions a month, and the plans page mentions no API key.

left_off.name: GitHub Models
left_off.public_note: GitHub Models was fully retired on 30 July 2026, so there is no free inference API there any more.

left_off.name: Hugging Face Inference API
left_off.free_allowance: No included monthly credits for free users; PRO gets $2.00 a month.
left_off.public_note: Hugging Face's Inference Providers give free accounts no included credits; you buy credits or go PRO ($2 a month in credits).

left_off.name: Mixedbread
left_off.free_allowance: $5 in one-time credits on the free Starter plan; 100 queries a minute.
left_off.public_note: Mixedbread's free Starter plan gives $5 in one-time credit for embeddings, reranking and search, no card needed. After that you upgrade to keep going.

left_off.name: Moonshot (Kimi)
left_off.free_allowance: No free tier; a minimum $1 recharge is needed to use the API ($5 voucher at $5 cumulative recharge).
left_off.public_note: Kimi's API has no free tier: a minimum $1 recharge is required to start, and a $5 voucher comes at $5 total recharge.

left_off.name: Plugsky
left_off.free_allowance: Free plan: 30 requests a minute; new accounts (after 2 Nov 2026) 100 requests and 50,000 tokens a day, 1 concurrent request; older accounts 500 requests and 250,000 tokens a day.
left_off.recycle: rolling window (about 5 hours as shown on its page; daily figures given)
left_off.public_note: Plugsky's free plan needs no card: 30 requests a minute, and new accounts get 100 requests and 50,000 tokens a day.

left_off.name: Replicate
left_off.public_note: Replicate bills for what you use, per second or per token. Its pricing page lists no free tier.

left_off.name: SambaNova Cloud
left_off.free_allowance: Free tier (no payment method linked) on gpt-oss-120b and gemma-4-31B-it: 20 requests a minute, 20 requests a day, 200,000 tokens a day. Preview models, may be removed at short notice.
left_off.public_note: SambaNova has a free tier with no payment method: 20 requests a minute, 20 a day and 200,000 tokens a day on preview models.

left_off.name: Together AI
left_off.public_note: Together AI has no free trial: you must buy at least $15 in credits before using the platform or creating keys.

left_off.name: ZSky.ai
left_off.free_allowance: Free plan: unlimited image/video generation in its web app, small watermark plate, no credits. API + MCP only on Max ($99/month) and Enterprise.
left_off.public_note: ZSky.ai's free plan needs no card, but it is for its web app: API access starts at the $99 Max plan.

tools.name: Apify
tools.public_note: Apify is a web-scraping platform, not an AI model API. Its free plan gives $5 of usage a month with no credit card.

tools.name: CheckMail1
tools.public_note: CheckMail1 is an email verification API with no company or country named. Its pages disagree on the free allowance ("100 free verifications every month" and "never expire"), on prices and on how to pay, and its documentation's way of sending the key is rejected by its own API.

tools.name: EmailVerify.io
tools.recycle: not confirmed: "every month" on the pricing page, "on sign up" elsewhere
tools.public_note: EmailVerify.io (Clustox LLC, Delaware) gives 100 free credits with no card. Its pricing page says every month and another page says on sign up, so the refill is not confirmed. It refuses at zero and says it never charges retroactively; a check covers syntax, mail records and a live handshake and sends no email, at up to 600 requests a minute.

tools.name: Exa
tools.free_allowance: $10 in credits (up to 2,500 Lite searches), refilled each month
tools.public_note: Exa is a search API, not an AI model API. Its free Starter plan gives $10 of credit (about 2,500 Lite searches) a month, no payment method.

tools.name: FreeSerp
tools.free_allowance: Free search API, no key, no signup, no rate plan
tools.public_note: FreeSerp is a free web search API that needs no key or signup and publishes no rate limit; it asks users to cache results.

tools.name: OCR.space
tools.free_allowance: 25,000 requests a month, 500 a day per IP address, 1 MB a file, 3 PDF pages
tools.public_note: OCR.space (a9t9 software GmbH, Germany) reads text from images and PDFs: 25,000 requests a month, 500 a day per IP address, 1 MB a file and 3 PDF pages, with no card. Searchable PDFs carry a watermark, and uploads are "deleted after processing".

tools.name: QuickEmailVerification
tools.public_note: QuickEmailVerification gives 100 free email verifications a day, resetting daily, with no card.

tools.name: Sniffmail
tools.free_allowance: 500 basic verifications a month (syntax, MX, disposable); deep SMTP checks paid
tools.public_note: Sniffmail gives 500 free basic email checks a month (syntax, MX, disposable detection) with no card. Deep mailbox checks are paid.

tools.name: SummarizeAPI
tools.free_allowance: 100 summaries a month on the free plan.
tools.public_note: SummarizeAPI's free plan gives 100 summaries a month with no credit card.

tools.name: Supabase
tools.public_note: Supabase's free plan is a database, storage and auth platform (500 MB database, 1 GB storage). It has no AI model API.

tools.name: Tavily
tools.free_allowance: 1,000 API credits a month on the Free Researcher plan
tools.public_note: Tavily's free plan gives 1,000 API credits a month for search, with no card.
